title: Nice tablecloth but not as rich colored as I had hoped
text:
Nice tablecloth but not as rich colored as I had hoped. This is a nice tablecloth and festive for Christmas. However, I was hoping for richer color combinations, particularly in the red and greens. I would have also liked more design on top and not just the center element. I did order a size too long but I rather have it longer than shorter. Although it is machine washable on cold in the gentle cycle and can be tumbled dried on low and then ironed lightly, I do not wash my tablecloths. I cover them with a plastic topper instead because I feel washing them ruins them.

Overall, this is festive but more subdued in its color combinations and the table-top edges lack detail with the exception of the center design. The outer rim of the tablecloth is well designed, however, but that is not easily seen.
